messages:
ryan_ops: Heads up — after the toolkit/driver rollout to eu-west GPU fleet we're seeing a spike of flaky pods on p4d nodes. errors look like symbol lookup / nccl comm failures.

maria_infra: seeing the same in metrics. networking looks fine; kernel logs show `unresolved symbol: cudaGetDeviceCount` on some containers.

alex_build: that sounds like a runtime/abi mismatch — some images still built against cuda 11 libs. Did the rollout include a container rebuild job?

ryan_ops: yes, we triggered the automated rebuild (devops-ci) last night to move base images to toolkit 12.0. But only ~60% of images got rebuilt before the pipeline timed out.

devops-ci: pipeline note: `rebuild-base-images` completed with exit code 0 for 42/70 targets; 28 timed out on `apt-get` due to flaky mirrors.

sam_oncall: quick repro log from node gpu-ef12: ```stderr
libcudart.so.12: undefined symbol: __cudaRegisterFatBinaryEnd
NCCL WARN Call to ncclCommInitRank returned 2 (unhandled cuda error)
```

maria_infra: that looks like mixed cuda runtime libs inside the container: some hosts have driver 535.x, others still on 525.x. toolkit 12 expects newer libnl/driver symbols.

ryan_ops: current plan: mark eu-west p4d pool as degraded, drain new jobs to fallback region (us-west), and roll back driver to 525 on nodes that failed after the rebuild. Thoughts?

alex_build: rollback might reduce perf. Could we instead pin container runtime to `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/cuda-11/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH` for the old images and mark rebuilt images with a label so the scheduler can route to them?

sam_oncall: short-term I prefer draining affected nodes. Risk of running mixed images is higher (unknown silent corruption). Draining gives us time to fix images and restart controlled.

maria_infra: I'll open a maintenance window for eu-west 02:00-05:00 UTC and start controlled rollback on a small subset (10% nodes) to validate. Also adding a preflight check to the rebuild pipeline to fail fast if lib mismatch detected.

devops-ci: adding `ldd`-based check to build: ensure binaries link to expected libcudart.so version. Will re-run rebuild for timed-out targets.

ryan_ops: FYI capacity/cost note: moving jobs to us-west will add ~20% cross-region egress for embedding syncs. ops budget will absorb short-term but flagging growth.

alex_build: long-term we need stronger invariants: either auto-rebuild all images before toolkit rollout or use multi-version runtime shim so containers opt into toolkit version.

maria_infra: agree. For now I'll patch the scheduler to prefer `image:cuda12-rebuilt=true` label when toolkit>=12. Also we'll add a nightly job to rebuild remaining images with mirror fallback.

sam_oncall: I'll coordinate paging rules so we don't get a flood during maintenance. tagging oncall rotations: @sam_oncall @ryan_ops.

infra-bot: maintenance scheduled: eu-west GPU pool 2026-03-19T02:00Z - 2026-03-19T05:00Z. Affected instances: p4d-*, p3dn-* (subset).

ryan_ops: thanks. I'll start a short postmortem draft after the rollback window. Key items: pipeline timeouts, mixed driver/device state, and scheduling steering labels.

alex_build: one more note — let's capture a failing container filesystem tarball before we restart it (for binary diff). I'll post a script in the thread.

ryan_ops: good call. paste it here when ready. :thumbsup:
